Sam (AE): ACME POC: they can't link frontend trace IDs to Console traces. Logs show requests but trace_id empty. Can SE+SRE swarm? :eyes:
Rina (SE): On it. Quick ask: are they sending X-Trace-Id from the browser or attaching in the SDK? Browsers need CORS expose headers.
Tom (SRE): If Cloudflare sits in front it may strip or not forward custom headers. Also rate limiter could short-circuit and return 429 before we record headers.
Sam (AE): They said Cloudflare + fetch streams. Pasted browser headers: x-trace-id: trace-abc123 present client-side.
Rina (SE): Request them to run a curl with the same header and paste the ALB/nginx access log. Example curl sent.
Helena (Platform Eng): I'll check ingress header whitelist and sink mapping. ExportBot: dd-forwarder sink for project-acme -> healthy.
Tom (SRE): I'll enable tenant debug to print req.headers for 20m and bump sampling to 100% for that window.
Rina (SE): Also ask for their Fluent Bit/Fluentd mapping. Common issue: parser doesn't create http.request.headers.x-trace-id path. Recommend using `modify`/Copy or a small Lua filter to set trace_id from headers.
Sam (AE): They also want 30d trace retention pricing and a security blurb on PII.
Helena (Platform Eng): Retention is add-on by GB/month, encrypted at rest, per-tenant config. I'll attach pricing excerpt.
Rina (SE): Short SQ blurb: trace_id is opaque request identifier, not a user id. We mask header values that match email patterns and avoid storing PII in trace fields.
Sam (AE): Plan: 1) Customer run curl+share edge log. 2) We watch debug logs + verify Datadog query. 3) If header present at edge but missing in ingestion, we update runbook and patch ingestion pipeline to copy trace_id into error logs for 429s.
ExportBot: telemetry-exporter: verification queued -> status: pending verification.
Sam (AE): Scheduling triage window tomorrow 9am PT. I'll post logs here after they run the curl. :white_check_mark:
